title: 蔚·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 短粉发与浓眉突出成年面容，黄铜蓝色大型机械拳套清楚醒目。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Vi is an adult woman with short bright-pink hair, strong eyebrows, and enormous brass-and-blue mechanical gauntlets. Her fully covering blue jacket, red scarf, opaque shirt, full trousers, and heavy boots preserve an athletic normal-proportioned body; omit readable facial lettering while keeping the distinctive gauntlet mechanisms and hair silhouette.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: pink, brass gold, denim blue, scarf red, lilac pencil shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
